why: A second open of the pane already on top runs a transition from the pane to itself, which is the pre-#318 `showVersusSetup(true)` twice: the one surface is marked LEAVING and then ENTERING, and the crossfade's settle hides it. The pane the player was looking at disappears a frame later. hud.navigation.test.ts (244): "showVersusSetup(true, cfg) twice keeps the pane open", measured failing on the pre-#318 tree with exactly this shape. Pinned by name since the hud suite was split (issue #511); its killers live in hud.navigation.test.ts.
